title: Independent Living Amount on the Entrance Fee Agreement Closing-Year Tax Letter
content:
The independent living amount the closing-year tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** rests on depends on how that account was closed: where the closing year holds move-out proration credits on the independent living ledger, the amount is the monthly fee charges of the closing year net of those credits; where it holds no such credit but a returned payment, the amount is the payments net of the returned payments; otherwise it is the payments posted in the closing year.

The residence fee share of the letter is the plan's monthly fee medical expense percentage of the independent living amount counted.

## Records read

The resident's **Independent Living Residency Agreement** ledger in the closing year: monthly fee charges, credits whose reason is move-out proration, payments, and returned payments.

## Condition table

| Move-out proration credit in the closing year | Returned payment in the closing year | Independent living amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Monthly fee charges less the proration credits |
| No | Yes | Payments less the returned payments |
| No | No | Payments posted |

## Hypothetical closing years

| Monthly fee charges | Proration credits | Payments | Returned payments | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 27900.00 | 2325.00 | 25200.00 | 0.00 | 25575.00 |
| 27900.00 | 0.00 | 29400.00 | 4650.00 | 24750.00 |
| 27900.00 | 0.00 | 25200.00 | 0.00 | 25200.00 |
